description: Reserved Instance / Savings Plan purchase plan for AWS. Must: analyze 90 days of usage data (EC2, RDS, ElastiCache), identify steady-state workloads suitable for commitment, size the commitment (1-year vs 3-year, all-upfront vs partial), apply resource tags for cost allocation, verify commitment coverage, and monitor utilization. Risk factors: over-committing on volatile workloads, under-committing leaving savings on the table, tag compliance gaps obscuring cost attribution. Tools available: aws CLI, Cost Explorer, CUR (Cost and Usage Report), terraform.
